namingVerification.title: Street Fighter 6 Character Guide | Arjun
namingVerification.note: The official guide’s embedded English text and animations were reviewed for Arm of Justice, Cruel Shoulder, Breathing Ring/Shockwave, Divine Pillar, Justice Beyond, Ghastly Interrogation, Indomitable Defense/Moral Breakdown and the three Supers. Justice Beyond automatically grabs and swings the Pillar after Shoulder contact; it is not a command grab on the defender. Pillar hold delays activation. Recoverable gray damage and the command throw’s change with existing gray health are distinct from a stock/install system. Actual practice excerpts use the independent tutorials’ visible commands, HUD and results.
